title: He doesn’t look dangerous… until you realize He is.
paragraphs: He doesn’t look dangerous… until you realize He is.

Not to you—
but to everything that’s been destroying you.
Because most people have it backwards.

They want a soft Savior…
a gentle Jesus…
a quiet Lamb who comforts but never confronts.
But Scripture doesn’t leave Him there.
“Behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah…” — Revelation 5:5
That’s a warning… and a promise.
The Lion is not safe in the way the world defines safety.
He doesn’t adjust truth to make you comfortable.
And that’s where the tension begins.

Because the same Lion who comes with authority…
first came in weakness.
Or at least—what looked like weakness.
Here’s the scandal no one expects:
“He was led like a lamb to the slaughter…” — Isaiah 53:7

The One with power to crush kings…
allowed Himself to be crushed.
Because your sin was louder than your prayers.
Because your guilt was deeper than your good works.
Because no amount of effort could close the gap between you and God.

So the Lion stepped down…
and became the Lamb.
Because this is no longer just a story.

Your hidden sin.
Your private compromises.
The version of you no one sees.
“He Himself bore our sins in His body on the tree…” — 1 Peter 2:24

Because you cannot experience grace
until you understand what it cost.
But don’t stay at the cross.
Because the story doesn’t end in blood.
He didn’t rise as a victim.
The Lion and the Lamb are not opposites.
They are the same Person… revealed in two moments.
And here’s where it hits hard again:
You don’t get to choose which version of Jesus you accept.
You don’t get the Lamb without the Lion.
You don’t get forgiveness without surrender.
You don’t get grace while holding on to rebellion.

Because the same Jesus who died for you…
is the same Jesus who will reign over you.
“God has made Him both Lord and Christ…” — Acts 2:36
This is not meant to push you away.
It’s meant to pull you in.
Because right now… in this moment…
The Lion is not roaring at you.

Not to fear…
but to surrender.

Not to run…
but to return.

Not to clean yourself up first…
but to come as you are.
You’ve tried to outrun your past.
You’ve tried to silence the weight inside your chest.
Because you were never meant to carry what only Christ can remove.
Here’s the truth that changes everything:

The safest place in the universe
is not away from the Lion—
Because when you belong to Him…
His power is no longer against you.
So what do you do now?

Not as a religious word…
but as a turning of the heart.
Let go of what’s killing you.
Stop delaying what you already know is true.
Because the same voice that whispers “come” today…
will one day shake the heavens.
If this stirred something in you—don’t ignore it.
He is holy, powerful, and full of mercy.
